thread:
paige.design: Quick UX sync Trace header actions. Current mock shows Export as the prominent action and an icon-only copy for the correlation id. I'm leaning toward making Copy the primary action. Thoughts? tony.product: +1 for copy-first. Folks paste corr ids into tickets/slack all the time. Export feels like a power-user action. leo.eng: Backend note: large exports can be CPU+IO heavy and run as async jobs. If Export remains primary we need to handle blocking states. If we demote it, we should still expose clear feedback for queued jobs. morgan.pm: Data check: over the last 90d copy events are ~3.7x exports. So behavioral data supports copy-first. aria.a11y: Accessibility checklist if we flip order: the correlation control must be keyboard-focusable, include an accessible name (e.g. aria-label="Copy correlation id 7f4a3b"), and we must announce the copy result via an aria-live region. Also avoid truncating the id for screen readers. paige.design: Proposed UX: left-to-right: [Copy 7f4a3b] (text chip) [Export \u25be] [More \u22ee]. Export opens dropdown with: JSON \u2014 full trace; CSV \u2014 flattened spans; HAR \u2014 request timeline. On <480px, collapse Export into the kebab menu. leo.eng: Implementation plan: exports return a job_id when they run longer than ~5s. Client can poll /api/exports/{job_id} or we can send a webhook/email when ready. For immediate UX: show toast "Export queued we'll notify you when it's ready." paige.design: Agree. UX microstates we need: idle, copying (transient check + SR announce), export queued, export ready (download CTA + SR announce). aria.a11y: Example SR pattern to use: ```
``` And after copy set srToast.textContent = 'Correlation ID 7f4a3b copied to clipboard'. paige.design: Good. Also thinking about a keyboard shortcut: when trace panel has focus, `c` copies the correlation id. We should show a small tooltip/hint "Press ? for shortcuts" and document it in the keyboard help. aria.a11y: Fine to add a shortcut as long as it's discoverable, doesn't conflict with app-global shortcuts, and we include it in the help modal. Ensure the shortcut is disabled when focus is inside a text entry. leo.eng: Analytics/telemetry: emit events `trace.copy_corr_id` (include trace_id, user_tier), `trace.export_requested` (format, trace_size), `trace.export_ready` (file_size, format). That will help validate the change post-rollout. morgan.pm: For rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with monitoring on copy/export counts and export error rates. If export errors spike, auto-rollback. paige.design: Touch target note: make the copy chip hit target at least 44x44px on touch. For visual polish ensure copy chip has >=4.5:1 contrast and a clear focus ring (2px). leo.eng: We'll keep DOM order matching logical order (Copy then Export) so screen readers navigate in the same sequence. Visual-only reordering is risky; don't do that. paige.design: I uploaded a quick mock: https://redwood.slack-imgs.com/T1/mock/trace-cta-patch.png deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/trace-cta-patch.png aria.a11y: Preview looks good. Final checks: confirm aria-labels include the full id, sr-toast uses aria-atomic, focus outline visible, and the copy control isn't icon-only without an accessible name. tony.product: Sounds like a plan. Please add the spec with keyboard flows, SR copy examples, and the analytics payload examples. We'll schedule dev work next sprint and do the canary rollout. paige.design: Will post the spec and a short checklist in this thread later today. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
